arguments.new:
import re

def slugify(text: str) -> str:
    """Turn arbitrary text into a URL slug: lowercase, ASCII letters and
    digits, words separated by single hyphens, no leading/trailing hyphens."""
    text = text.lower()
    # Replace any run of non-alphanumeric ASCII characters with a single hyphen
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text)
    # Strip leading/trailing hyphens
    return text.strip("-")

arguments.summary: Fix slugify to collapse runs of non-alphanumeric characters into a single hyphen and strip leading/trailing hyphens. This prevents double and trailing hyphens (e.g., "Hello,  World!" -> "hello-world").
